products.name: The Five Minute Journal
products.quantity: One undated journal, 264 pages, about six months of daily prompts
products.why_fit: For visitors who choose short writing rituals and daily reflection.
products.limitation: A structured gratitude journal, not a blank notebook or personalized astrology report.

products.name: Get Closer Conversation Game: Couples
products.why_fit: A tangible next step for a couple who wants a shared conversation activity.
products.limitation: Requires two willing participants; no claim to measure relationship health or predict success.

products.name: The Starseed Oracle
products.why_fit: For visitors who enjoy starseed-inspired symbolism and drawing reflection cards.
products.limitation: Spiritual symbolism; do not frame a card deck or quiz as proof of extraterrestrial identity. Merchant markup simultaneously exposes sold-out and in-stock text, so avoid asserting stock.

products.name: Moonology Oracle Cards
products.why_fit: For users who prefer moon imagery and card-based reflection to writing.
products.limitation: Oracle deck, not a standard 78-card tarot deck. No promise that the cards predict events. Stock markup conflicts, so avoid stock claims.

Merchant flavor notes: refreshing, sharp, smooth

products.limitation: Loose leaf needs an infuser. Exclude if mint is an avoided ingredient; do not suggest physiological or supernatural benefits.

implementation_notes: Use ordinary merchant product links now. Do not invent affiliate IDs, describe these merchants as current partners, or claim commissions are connected.
Use 'View at [merchant]' or 'Check current price' for external product CTAs. Merchant owns price and checkout; prices in this evidence file are dated observations.

Merchant image URLs are reference product photography. Obtain partner-authorized creative rights/feed before scaled live promotion; never imply permission was verified merely because a URL is publicly accessible.
Recommend tea by stated flavor, caffeine preference and ingredient avoidance, not by alleged celestial biology. Frame starseed outcomes as playful spiritual archetypes.
Keep health, wealth, relationship certainty, and extraterrestrial origin claims out of report outcomes. Price tests and conversion assumptions below are experiments, not demonstrated demand.
Record concept_id, offer_id, quiz completion and outbound product click without birth dates, partner names, email, or report text in analytics.
